(To be submitted on Bidder's Official Letterhead)

To

The {{tenderInvitingAuthority}},

{{departmentName}},

Himachal Pradesh University, Summer Hill, Shimla - 171005.

title: Annexure-IV: Proforma of Guarantee for Supply of Spares during and Post Warranty Period
description: Formal undertaking guaranteeing continuous supply of genuine spare parts and accessories for at least 10 years.
contentTemplate:
Annexure-IV

Proforma of Guarantee for Supply of Spares during and Post Warranty Period

(To be submitted on Official Letterhead)

Dated: ……………………..

To

The {{tenderInvitingAuthority}},

{{departmentName}},

Himachal Pradesh University, Summer Hill, Shimla - 171005.

Sir,

In consideration of Himachal Pradesh University placing the purchase order for {{tenderName}} (Tender No. {{tenderNo}}), we hereby furnish this guarantee for the supply of spare parts and components.

1. We guarantee that genuine spare parts, consumables, and software updates for the offered model shall be available and supplied for a minimum period of 10 (Ten) years from the date of successful installation.

2. In the event of discontinuation of production of the spare parts, we will give advance notice of at least 12 months to enable the University to procure required quantities, and furnish blueprints/specifications of the spare parts at no cost.

3. We guarantee that the prices of spare parts during the post-warranty period will remain reasonable and benchmarked to international list prices.

Authorized Signatory: ___________________________

Name & Designation: _________________________
Company Seal: _________________________
